text:
mia: quick heads-up from a customer onboarding: SDKs not matching REST on auth retry + param names. digging in now.

mia: symptom: rotating short-lived creds (STS) -> REST path gets 401 then gateway returns Retry-After and auto-retries; the Node + Python SDKs bubble 401 up immediately.

mia: tiny repro:
```bash
# REST (works because gateway retries)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hey"}'

# Node (fails unless token refreshed client-side)
await client.generate({model: 'gpt-small', input: 'hey'})
```

sam: thanks. which client versions? have we changed the auth hook recently?

mia: Node 0.9.4, Python 0.10.1. we recently replaced `onAuthRefresh` with `getAuthToken` in some SDKs; suspect lifecycle mismatch where SDK gives up before infra retry layer runs.

harpreet: i can repro with STS locally. also saw a 307 region redirect in one trace that Node didn't follow. REST followed and retried, SDK errored.

mia: relevant headers from gateway logs: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`, `retry-after: 1`, `x-request-id: rwd-9f7`. SDK error object only surfaced status and request id, no Retry-After.

sam: sounds like two gaps: 1) SDK HTTP wrapper is dropping or not surfacing Retry-After and not applying the gateway's retry policy, 2) redirect handling (307) is not followed by default in some clients.

sam: action: i'll audit the transport wrappers across Node/Python to preserve Retry-After, enable default backoff with jitter, and allow following same-host 307 redirects.

ci-bot: Issue RED-3798 created: "SDK parity: honor Retry-After + follow 307 for region routing; fix auth hook lifecycle" assigned to sam.

mia: extra nit: REST param is `stream=true` but SDKs are inconsistent: Node uses `enableStreaming`, Python uses `stream`. caused confusion in sample apps. Can we standardize?

sam: yep will include parameter name harmonization in the PR. probably expose both aliases for one release then remove deprecated name.

harpreet: also saw embedding batch endpoint missing in Python client for bulk use — raised a separate note.

mia: thanks. suggested tests: simulate rotating token with gateway returning 401 + Retry-After, assert SDK retries and succeeds; simulate 307 cross-region redirect and ensure SDK follows for same-account domains.

sam: will add unit + integration tests and a changelog note. planning small patch bump (0.9.5 / 0.10.2).

doc-bot: Reminder: update quickstart snippets and migration guide for auth hook shape change.

mia: i'll attach a tiny repro repo after PR lands. thanks for quick triage.

sam: thanks — will post PR link here when ready.

mia: closing loop for now.
